title: Objectives: question is not valid for Omnipod - user can not answer correctly
body:
AndroidAPS 2.8.2

**Problem:** Objectives for Omnipod users.

Asking user on _what to do when received less insuline than the pump history suggests..._
(see screenshot attached)

Omnipod users can never answer the question correctly.
Question apparently was compiled with standard "_external_" insulin pumps in mind.
With Omnipod there is no "**pump history**" to check.

As for Omnipod users there is no way to check if AAPS and pump agree on the amount of insulin received answer #4 ("Compare values in AndroidAPS and pump history") is wrong. But AAPS expects user to select it as true.
